features.text: Dark mode works on all devices.

bug_fixes.text: Fixed the checkout crash that happened when a coupon was applied.

changed_behaviour.text: The order cancellation window is reduced from 5 minutes to 2 minutes.

qa_summary.text: UPI autopay tested on Android 13 and 14. All 12 test cases passed.

Dark mode checked on Android only. iOS was not tested.
